content: We need to determine number of carbonyl (C=O) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of the molecule. We can use IR spectra to detect carbonyl stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). The cheapest is IR maybe. Use ir_spectra tool. Then count carbonyl peaks (around 1700-1750 cm-1 for typical carbonyl). Let's get IR.
